plot_hooks.title: The Mystery of Death House
plot_hooks.summary: The characters are drawn into the haunted Death House by illusions of children and local rumors of a monster trapped within the basement.
plot_hooks.how_party_learns: Characters encounter the illusory children Rose and Thorn who point towards the house, mentioning a monster in the basement.
plot_hooks.dm_notes: Players should be guided to the village of Barovia first, then to the house, using the 'Creeping Fog' hook as an introduction.

thread_curse_stradh_intro.title: Introduction to Strahd’s Domain and Death House
thread_curse_stradh_intro.description: The party arrives in Strahd's domain, guided by the mists, and eventually reaches the village of Barovia and Death House.
thread_curse_stradh_intro.hook: The mists of Ravenloft force the party to the village and the Death House.
thread_curse_stradh_intro.current_objective: Explore the Death House and investigate the mystery of the monster trapped in the basement.
thread_curse_stradh_intro.next_milestone: Gain access to the secret stairs in the attic (area 21).

known_to_players: Death House is haunted by spirits of the Durst family and cultists.
Rose and Thorn are children tied to the house.
There is a monster (illusory or real) trapped in the basement.
truth_hidden: Rose and Thorn outside the house are illusions controlled by the house.
The children are actually dead and their ghosts haunt the dungeon.
The real monster is connected to the ritual chamber and the cult’s demands.
The house is magically repairing itself after destruction.

success_conditions: Party gains access to secret attic stairs.
Party survives or placates the house’s threats in the dungeon.
Party escapes the house advancing to 3rd level.
failure_conditions: Party is destroyed or trapped indefinitely in the house.
Party fails to escape or survive the dungeon level rituals.
thread_curse_stradh_intro.dm_notes: Steer players to explore in-depth, manage the illusion of the children, and reveal secrets gradually.

thread_death_house_dungeon.title: Exploration and Survival in the Death House Dungeon
thread_death_house_dungeon.description: The party explores the dungeon beneath Death House, faces traps, ghosts, and cult remnants, culminating in the ritual chamber showdown.
thread_death_house_dungeon.hook: The secret stairway leads the party into the dungeon where an eerie chant and hostile entities await.
thread_death_house_dungeon.current_objective: Survive the dungeon encounters and resolve the cult's demands by sacrificing or defeating the shambling mound.
thread_death_house_dungeon.next_milestone: Make the sacrifice on the ritual altar or defeat the shambling mound and escape.

known_to_players: The dungeon contains traps, undead cultists, and ghosts of children.
A ritual chamber demands a sacrifice for the cult.
The ghosts of Rose and Thorn can possess characters.
truth_hidden: The cultists are servants of Strahd and were killed for displeasing him.
The house repairs itself magically except the dungeon.
Placing children's remains in crypts can release their spirits.
Failure to sacrifice will provoke an attack by the shambling mound and house defenses.

success_conditions: Sacrifice is made on altar to appease the cult, allowing safe escape.
Or the shambling mound is defeated and party escapes the house alive.
failure_conditions: Party is killed by cult remnants or shambling mound.
Party fails to escape the house or becomes possessed permanently.
thread_death_house_dungeon.dm_notes: Present moral dilemma of sacrifice, emphasize eerie atmosphere and trap danger.

loc_barovia_village.name: Village of Barovia
loc_barovia_village.dm_notes: Characters are funneled here by the mists of Ravenloft before approaching Death House.

loc_death_house.name: Death House
loc_death_house.dm_notes: The house itself is an entity regenerating after damage. Dungeon is separate and does not regenerate. Illusions used to lure visitors.

area_1_entrance.name: Entrance

description.read_aloud: A wrought-iron gate with rusty hinges stands slightly ajar leading into a stone portico with oil lamps hanging from its ceiling. Double oaken doors open into a grand foyer.
description.summary: The entryway of Death House with a rusty gate and oil lamps.

area_1_entrance.dm_notes: The gate scrapes loudly when opened; part of the atmospheric introduction.

area_2_main_hall.name: Main Hall

description.read_aloud: A wide hall with a black marble fireplace, adorned with a longsword above it, and a sweeping red marble staircase that leads upward. The walls are ornately decorated with vines, flowers, and hidden sinister images of serpents and skulls.
description.summary: Large wood-paneled hall with fireplace and grand staircase.

puzzles.description: Detect hidden serpents and skulls in wall paneling, DC 12 Wisdom (Perception).

area_2_main_hall.dm_notes: Wall carvings conceal sinister images to hint at the house's malevolence.

area_3_den_of_wolves.name: Den of Wolves

description.read_aloud: An oak-paneled hunter’s den containing a stag’s head above the fireplace and three stuffed wolves positioned around the room. Two padded chairs face the hearth beside an oak table with wine and a candle.
description.summary: Hunter’s den with animal trophies and furniture.

traps.description: Hidden trapdoor on southwest corner, undetectable until approached from below.

skill_challenges.description: East cabinet lock can be picked with thieves' tools DC 15 Dexterity check.

area_3_den_of_wolves.dm_notes: Trapdoor is hidden supernaturally and only revealed when accessed from below.

area_4_kitchen_pantry.name: Kitchen and Pantry

description.read_aloud: A tidy kitchen with cookware and utensils neat on shelves. A stone dome-shaped oven connects to a stove pipe. A door leads to a well-stocked pantry with bland but fresh food.
description.summary: Functional kitchen and food pantry.

area_4_kitchen_pantry.dm_notes: Contains dumbwaiter connecting to servants' quarters and master bedroom.

area_5_dining_room.name: Dining Room

description.read_aloud: Large wood-paneled room with mahogany table surrounded by eight chairs. Crystal chandelier above, silverware and crystalware on the table. Wall panels carved with elegant deer scenes and hidden twisted faces and wolves.
description.summary: Formal dining room richly decorated.

puzzles.description: Detect twisted faces and wolves in paneling, DC 12 Wisdom (Perception).

area_5_dining_room.dm_notes: Removal of silverware, crystalware, portrait, tapestry causes decay.

description.read_aloud: Hall with unlit oil lamps and a family portrait showing Durst family and a baby. Suits of armor flank doors, carved youths fighting bats on doors. Red marble staircase spirals upward with a cold draft.
description.summary: Upper hall with ominous decor.

puzzles.description: Detect youths fighting bats on doors, DC 12 Wisdom (Perception).

description.read_aloud: Undecorated bedroom with two beds, empty footlockers and tidy servants’ uniforms. Dumbwaiter with button to kitchen.
description.summary: Servants quarters with basic furnishings.

area_8_library.name: Library

description.read_aloud: Room with red velvet drapes, mahogany desk facing entrance and fireplace, picture of windmill, overstuffed chairs, floor-to-ceiling bookshelves with hundreds of tomes and a rolling ladder.
description.summary: House master’s library with extensive tomes and a secret door.

puzzles.description: Detect secret door disguised as red-covered book, DC 13 Wisdom (Perception).
Recognize rituals in secret room books, DC 12 Intelligence (Arcana).

area_8_library.dm_notes: Secret door leads to ritual room with dead adventurer and Strahd’s letter.

description.read_aloud: Room filled with tomes on fiend summoning and necromantic rituals, a heavy wooden chest containing a poisoned skeleton clutching a letter from Strahd.
description.summary: Cult ritual library and a poisoned chest with dead adventurer.

traps.description: Three darts stuck in skeleton; trap no longer functional.

description.read_aloud: Elegant hall with gossamer drapes, brass chandelier, upholstered chairs, stained-glass wall hangings of musicians, harpsichord and large harp, alabaster figurines of skeleton dancers.
description.summary: Music room with eerie skeletal dancer figurines.

description.read_aloud: Dusty balcony with black plate armor animated suit that attacks on damage or proximity. Carvings of woodland scenes with hidden corpses and worms in the walls.
description.summary: Attack balcony with animated armor and sinister carvings.

puzzles.description: Detect secret door to attic, DC 15 Wisdom (Perception).

description.read_aloud: Dusty cobwebbed master bedroom with four-poster bed, empty wardrobes, vanity with jewelry box, tiger-skin rug and a parlor with porcelain bowl and jug. Doors include a balcony and a dust-choked closet.
description.summary: Master bedroom rich in decay and secrets.

description.read_aloud: Dark room with wooden clawfoot tub, small iron stove with kettle, and barrel beneath a now-nonfunctional water spigot.
description.summary: Old bathroom with broken plumbing.

description.read_aloud: Dusty shelves with folded sheets, blankets, old soap bars, and a cobweb-covered animated broom that attacks any creature within 5 feet.
description.summary: Dusty storage with animated broom trap.

traps.description: Animated broom attacks intruders within 5 feet.

area_15_nursemaid_suite.name: Nursemaid’s Suite

description.read_aloud: Dusty bedroom and adjacent nursery with stained glass double doors to balcony. Spectral nursemaid haunts the room; nursery contains a crib with tightly wrapped, empty baby bundle.
description.summary: Haunted nursemaid’s room with eerie nursery.

puzzles.description: Detect eyeballs among ivy berries on mirror frame, DC 12 Wisdom (Perception).
Find secret door behind mirror, DC 15 Wisdom (Perception).

area_15_nursemaid_suite.dm_notes: Specter attacks upon entry to nursery unless defeated.

description.read_aloud: Bare hall choked with dust and cobwebs. Door to children’s room locked with padlock.
description.summary: Dusty attic hallway with locked door to children’s room.

puzzles.description: Door to children’s room locked with padlock, key in library or thieves' tools DC 15 Dexterity check.

description.read_aloud: Dust-choked room with slender bed, nightstand, iron stove, writing desk and rocking chair. Smiling doll in window box draped in cobwebs.
description.summary: Dusty spare bedroom with creepy doll.

area_18_storage_room.name: Storage Room

description.read_aloud: Dusty chamber with old furniture covered in white sheets. Wooden trunk contains skeletal remains of nursemaid.
description.summary: Storage with old furniture and skeletal remains.

skill_challenges.description: Identify knife wounds on nursemaid’s remains, DC 14 Wisdom (Medicine).

area_18_storage_room.dm_notes: Specter attacks if remains disturbed unless previously defeated.

description.read_aloud: Web-filled room with slender bed, nightstand, rocking chair, empty wardrobe, and a small iron stove.
description.summary: Dusty spare bedroom with minimal furnishings.

area_20_childrens_room.name: Children’s Room

description.read_aloud: Bricked-up windowed room with two small wood-framed beds, a toy chest, and a dollhouse replicating Death House. Two small skeletons of Rose and Thorn lie in the middle of the floor.
description.summary: Children’s room with skeletal remains and miniature dollhouse.

puzzles.description: Detect all secret doors on dollhouse, DC 15 Wisdom (Perception).

area_20_childrens_room.dm_notes: Skeletons are of children Rose and Thorn; their spirits haunt the dungeon.

area_21_attic.name: Secret Stairs / Attic

description.read_aloud: Narrow spiral staircase descending 50 feet to dungeon level. Filled with thick cobwebs that limit visibility.
description.summary: Attic area containing secret stairs to dungeon.

area_21_attic.dm_notes: Stairs appear only if triggered by finding Strahd’s letter or dollhouse secret door.

area_22_dungeon_level_access.name: Dungeon Level Access

description.read_aloud: Wooden spiral staircase from attic ends here; narrow tunnels branch east and west.
description.summary: Dungeon entry point under the house.

area_22_dungeon_level_access.dm_notes: Eerie chanting can be heard, direction not yet clear.

area_23_family_crypts.name: Family Crypts

description.read_aloud: Several crypt chambers sealed with stone slabs. Most contain empty coffins. Crypts for Rose and Thorn marked with empty stone coffins.
description.summary: Crypts of family members beneath the house.

puzzles.description: Remove stone slab, DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check.

area_23_family_crypts.dm_notes: Placing children’s skeletal remains in respective crypts can put spirits to rest.

description.read_aloud: Room with wooden table and chairs, alcoves containing straw pallets to the west.
description.summary: Sleeping quarters for cult initiates.

area_25_well_and_cultist_quarters.name: Well and Cultist Quarters

description.read_aloud: Well shaft descending to water-filled cistern. Five side rooms with moldy beds and locked wooden chests securing personal belongings and valuables.
description.summary: Well and living quarters for senior cultists.

puzzles.description: Pick padlocks on chests, DC 15 Dexterity check.

area_25_well_and_cultist_quarters.dm_notes: Chests contain loot from past adventurers captured and killed.

description.read_aloud: A hidden pit trap covered with rotted wood and dirt, containing sharp wooden spikes. The first creature to step onto the cover falls and takes bludgeoning and piercing damage.
description.summary: Concealed spiked pit trap in the tunnel.

traps.description: 5-foot long, 10-foot deep pit trap covered under rotted wooden planks and dirt.

skill_challenges.description: Detect absence of footprints indicating hidden trap, DC 15 Wisdom (Perception).

description.read_aloud: Plain wooden table with long benches among moldy humanoid bones and remains. Darkened alcove on the south wall harboring a creature.
description.summary: Cult banquet hall with bones and hidden monster.

description.read_aloud: Empty alcove containing a grick that attacks any creature within 5 feet. Character with Wisdom (Perception) under 12 is surprised.
description.summary: Dangerous larder housing a grick.

area_29_ghoulish_encounter.name: Ghoulish Encounter

description.read_aloud: Crossroads where four ghouls (cultists) rise to attack upon arrival.
description.summary: Battle site with ghouls ambushing characters.

area_29_ghoulish_encounter.dm_notes: Use ghouls to surprise and challenge players.

description.read_aloud: 20-foot-long staircase descending deeper into the dungeon where chanting grows louder.
description.summary: Dungeon stairs to ritual chamber.

area_31_darklords_shrine.name: Darklord’s Shrine

description.read_aloud: Room festooned with moldy skeletons hanging from shackles. A painted wooden statue of Strahd holding a crystal orb with a wolf at his side, which when touched triggers shadow attacks.
description.summary: Cultist shrine depicting Strahd; triggers shadow attacks if disturbed.

puzzles.description: Find concealed door in east wall, DC 10 Wisdom (Perception).

area_31_darklords_shrine.dm_notes: Shadows attack if creature interacts with statue or orb.

area_32_hidden_trapdoor.name: Hidden Trapdoor

description.read_aloud: Trapdoor bolted shut that can be pushed open to the den above (area 3).
description.summary: Trapdoor linking to the den above.

area_32_hidden_trapdoor.dm_notes: Once opened remains usable as dungeon access.

area_33_cult_leaders_den.name: Cult Leaders’ Den

description.read_aloud: Room with a treasure table and chairs, the door in the corner is a mimic which attacks on contact or damage.
description.summary: Cult leaders’ room guarded by a mimic door.

area_33_cult_leaders_den.dm_notes: Mimic aggressively attacks touch or damage.

area_34_cult_leaders_quarters.name: Cult Leaders’ Quarters

description.read_aloud: Large wooden bed and wardrobe with iron candlesticks, open crate with torches and candles, and an unlocked footlocker containing gear and magic items. Hiding ghasts attack if footlocker is disturbed.
description.summary: Cult leaders' quarters with stored treasures and hidden ghasts.

area_34_cult_leaders_quarters.dm_notes: Ghasts emerge to attack when footlocker looted.

area_35_reliquary.name: Reliquary

description.read_aloud: Room with niches containing mummified or relic items used in cult rituals. Chanting of 'He is the Ancient. He is the Land' endlessly echoes.
description.summary: Cult relic storage with persistent chanting.

area_35_reliquary.dm_notes: Items are worthless individually but represent cult's twisted faith.

description.read_aloud: Prison alcoves with rusty shackles on walls, empty apart from bones on floor. Secret door to area 38 hidden in south wall.
description.summary: Prison area with human remains and concealed door.

puzzles.description: Find secret door in south wall, DC 15 Wisdom (Perception).

description.read_aloud: Tunnel blocked by rusty iron portcullis that can be lifted with DC 20 Strength or operated from the ritual chamber.
description.summary: Water-filled tunnel blocked by portcullis.

area_38_ritual_chamber.name: Ritual Chamber

description.read_aloud: A 40-foot-square sunken room with stone pillars, a stone altar stained with blood, rusty chains hanging from ceiling. Murky water covers floor with stairs leading up to ledges. Shambling mound lurks in refuse pile.
description.summary: Sunken cult ritual chamber and source of chanting.

puzzles.description: Identify need to sacrifice on altar, DC 11 Intelligence (Religion) or Wisdom (Insight).

area_38_ritual_chamber.dm_notes: Sacrifice appeases cult; denying brings wrath and attacks by shambling mound and house defenses.

item_letter_strahd.name: Letter from Strahd von Zarovich
item_letter_strahd.description: A letter written by Strahd to the cultists, declaring they are not his servants, cursing them.
item_letter_strahd.lore: Provides insight into cult's relation to Strahd.
item_letter_strahd.acquisition_method: Found in secret room behind library.
item_letter_strahd.quest_significance: Triggers appearance of secret attic stairs.
item_letter_strahd.dm_notes: The letter is apparently genuine and key to unlocking further exploration.

item_windmill_deed.name: Deed to Windmill
item_windmill_deed.description: Deed to a windmill located east of Vallaki, connected to the Durst family property.
item_windmill_deed.acquisition_method: Found in secret room behind library.
item_windmill_deed.quest_significance: Part of family property bequeathed to children.

item_house_deed.name: Deed to Death House
item_house_deed.description: Legal deed to the Death House property, bequeathed to Rosavalda and Thornboldt Durst.
item_house_deed.acquisition_method: Found in secret room behind library.

item_signed_will.name: Signed Will of Gustav and Elisabeth Durst
item_signed_will.description: Will bequeathing death house and other properties to the Durst children.
item_signed_will.acquisition_method: Found in secret room behind library.
item_signed_will.quest_significance: Supports story of the Durst family.

item_longsword_windmill_hilt.name: Longsword with Windmill Cameo
item_longsword_windmill_hilt.description: Nonmagical longsword mounted above fireplace with a windmill design on hilt.

item_crossbows_and_bolts.name: Crossbows and Bolts
item_crossbows_and_bolts.description: Heavy, light, and hand crossbows with 20 bolts each.
item_crossbows_and_bolts.acquisition_method: Locked cabinet in the Den of Wolves.

item_deck_of_playing_cards.name: Deck of Playing Cards
item_deck_of_playing_cards.description: A standard deck of playing cards inside a small box.
item_deck_of_playing_cards.acquisition_method: North cabinet in the Den of Wolves.

item_iron_key_library.name: Iron Key
item_iron_key_library.description: Iron key found in library desk drawer used to unlock door to area 20.

item_jewelry_box.name: Jewelry Box
item_jewelry_box.description: Silver jewelry box with gold filigree containing three gold rings and a platinum necklace with a topaz pendant.

item_cloak_of_protection.name: Cloak of Protection
item_cloak_of_protection.description: A magical cloak granting +1 bonus to AC and saving throws.
item_cloak_of_protection.lore: Taken from adventurers killed by cult.
item_cloak_of_protection.acquisition_method: Found in footlocker in cult leaders' quarters.

item_potions_of_healing.name: Potions of Healing
item_potions_of_healing.description: Potions that restore hit points when consumed.

item_spellbook.name: Spellbook
item_spellbook.description: Yellow leather-bound spellbook containing wizard spells of 1st and 2nd levels.
item_spellbook.lore: From fallen adventurers taken by cult.
item_spellbook.acquisition_method: In footlocker in cult leaders' quarters.

item_magic_items_cultists.name: Miscellaneous Magic Items
item_magic_items_cultists.description: Includes chain shirt, thieves’ tools, bullseye lantern, flask of alchemist’s fire, and spellbook.
item_magic_items_cultists.acquisition_method: In footlocker in cult leaders' quarters.

item_crystal_orb.name: Crystal Orb
item_crystal_orb.description: A smoky-gray crystal orb used as an arcane focus but not magical itself.
item_crystal_orb.lore: Held by painted statue of Strahd.

item_toy_chest.name: Toy Chest
item_toy_chest.description: Chest containing stuffed animals and toys.

item_dollhouse.name: Dollhouse Replica of Death House
item_dollhouse.description: Miniature dollhouse that is a perfect replica of Death House containing all secret doors including the attic spiral staircase.
item_dollhouse.lore: Used by children’s ghosts to point path and lure the living.
item_dollhouse.quest_significance: Key to finding secret attic stairs.

item_gold_ring_on_skeleton.name: Gold Ring on Skeleton
item_gold_ring_on_skeleton.description: Gold ring worth 25 gp found on skeletal cult member finger.

item_gold_and_silver_coins.name: Gold and Silver Coins in Human Skin Pouch
item_gold_and_silver_coins.description: Pouch made of human skin containing 11 gp and 60 sp.

item_moss_agates.name: Moss Agates
item_moss_agates.description: Three moss agates worth 10 gp each.

item_black_leather_eye_patch.name: Black Leather Eye Patch with Carnelian
item_black_leather_eye_patch.description: Black leather eye patch with a carnelian gem sewn in, worth 50 gp.

item_ivory_hairbrush.name: Ivory Hairbrush with Silver Bristles
item_ivory_hairbrush.description: Ivory hairbrush with silver bristles, worth 25 gp.

npc_rose_durst.name: Rosavalda "Rose" Durst
npc_rose_durst.relationship_to_party: initially guides players towards house, secret lure
npc_rose_durst.appearance: Ten-year-old girl wearing a tattered dress, illusions with glowing eyes.
secrets: She is an illusion created by the house.
She does not know she is not real.
information_can_provide: There is a monster in the basement
Their parents keep the monster locked
npc_rose_durst.dm_notes: Vanished if attacked or forced inside house.

npc_thorn_durst.name: Thornboldt "Thorn" Durst
npc_thorn_durst.relationship_to_party: initially guides players towards house, secret lure
npc_thorn_durst.appearance: Seven-year-old boy holding stuffed doll, illusory.
secrets: He is an illusion created by the house.
He does not know he is not real.
information_can_provide: There is a monster in the basement
Their parents keep the monster locked
npc_thorn_durst.dm_notes: Vanished if attacked or forced inside house.

npc_rose_durst_ghost.name: Ghost of Rosavalda "Rose" Durst
npc_rose_durst_ghost.appearance: Small ghostly girl with glowing aura.
npc_rose_durst_ghost.motivation: Protect players and seek rest after bones are interred.
information_can_provide: Children died locked in attic by parents
Hiding the secret of the monster
npc_rose_durst_ghost.dm_notes: Lacks Horrifying Visage, 35 HP, 3 CR; can be intimidated to leave host.

npc_thorn_durst_ghost.name: Ghost of Thornboldt "Thorn" Durst
npc_thorn_durst_ghost.appearance: Small ghostly boy clutching a doll.
npc_thorn_durst_ghost.motivation: Protect players and find rest after bones are interred.
npc_thorn_durst_ghost.dm_notes: Same stats as Rose; impaired fears and possession abilities differ.

npc_gustav_durst_ghast.name: Ghast of Gustav Durst
secrets: Bursts forth from hidden cavity to attack

npc_elisabeth_durst_ghast.name: Ghast of Elisabeth Durst
secrets: Bursts forth from hidden cavity to attack

npc_nursemaid_specter.name: Nursemaid’s Spirit
npc_nursemaid_specter.appearance: Skeletal spirit of thin young woman
secrets: Born of affair with master of house
Haunts nursery and attacks on door opening
npc_nursemaid_specter.dm_notes: Attacks when nursery door opened unless previously defeated.

npc_animated_armor.name: Animated Armor
npc_animated_armor.appearance: Suit of black plate armor draped in cobwebs
npc_animated_armor.dm_notes: Attacks immediately upon taking damage or close proximity.

npc_grick.name: Grick
npc_grick.appearance: Tentacled predator lurking in dark alcove

npc_ghouls.name: Ghouls
npc_ghouls.motivation: Defend cult remains and kill intruders

npc_mimic.name: Mimic
npc_mimic.appearance: Mimicked door at southwest corner of room

npc_shadows.name: Shadows
npc_shadows.appearance: Dark spirit shadows around statue of Strahd

npc_shambling_mound.name: Lorghoth the Decayer (Shambling Mound)
npc_shambling_mound.appearance: Large shambling mound in refuse pile
npc_shambling_mound.motivation: Protect cult ritual site; destroy intruders
npc_shambling_mound.dm_notes: Summoned if sacrifice denied; pursues prey beyond ritual chamber.

faction_death_house_cult.name: Durst Family Cult
faction_death_house_cult.ideology: Dark ritualistic indoctrination and domination through fear and sacrifice.
faction_death_house_cult.dm_notes: The cult no longer fully active but their spirits and legacy haunt the house.

consequence_cult_sacrifice.trigger: Party sacrifices a creature on altar in ritual chamber.
consequence_cult_sacrifice.effect: Cultists disappear, chanting fades, house no longer threatens party; mists recede.
consequence_cult_sacrifice.potential_payoff: Party advances to 3rd level and leaves house unharmed.

consequence_cult_denied.trigger: Party refuses sacrifice or kills shambling mound.
consequence_cult_denied.effect: House attacks aggressively with magical architectural changes and poison smoke; party must fight to escape.
consequence_cult_denied.potential_payoff: Party escapes and advances to 3rd level after surviving assaults.
consequence_cult_denied.dm_notes: Triggers house hostility, forcing combat and challenge.

secret_stairs_revealed.description: Whether the secret stairs in the attic have been revealed.
secret_stairs_revealed.changes_when: Obtaining Strahd's letter or discovering dollhouse secret door.

cult_sacrifice_made.description: Whether the cult's demanded sacrifice has been made.
cult_sacrifice_made.changes_when: If party sacrifices a creature on the altar.

shambling_mound_awakened.description: If shambling mound is awakened due to denial of sacrifice.
shambling_mound_awakened.changes_when: Sacrifice is denied and chanting awakens shambling mound.

house_self_repair.description: Timer for house to self-repair after destruction (excluding dungeon).
house_self_repair.on_expire: House repairs completely in 2d6 hours following 1d10 days.

trigger_conditions: Sacrifice denied at ritual altar in area 38
encounter_shambling_mound.description: Large shambling mound awakened in ritual chamber, attacks party relentlessly.
encounter_shambling_mound.dm_notes: Summoned to punish and kill party if ritual sacrifice is denied.

trigger_conditions: Touching or taking crystal orb from statue in shrine.
encounter_shadow_guards.description: Five shadows (spirits of cultists) attack those disturbing shrine.
encounter_shadow_guards.dm_notes: Shadows pursue fleeing characters beyond shrine.

trigger_conditions: Reaching midpoint of dungeon tunnels at ghoulish encounter area.
encounter_ghouls.description: Four ghouls (former cultists) rise and attack the party.

branch_sacrifice.condition: Players choose to sacrifice a creature to appease cult at ritual altar.
branch_sacrifice.new_objective: Escape Death House safely after sacrifice.
branch_sacrifice.narrative_impact: Mists recede, house becomes friendly; players advance to 3rd level.

branch_defy_cult.condition: Players refuse to sacrifice and/or kill shambling mound.
branch_defy_cult.new_objective: Survive and escape violent house defenses and pursuing shambling mound.
branch_defy_cult.narrative_impact: House attacks with magical traps and environmental hazards; players advance to 3rd level after escape.
branch_defy_cult.dm_notes: Aggressive resolution; players face increased danger.
